camel_example: aliyun resourcedirectorymaster ListAccountsForParent --region cn-hangzhou --IncludeTags true --Tag.1.Key tag_key --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --Tag.1.Value tag_value --QueryKeyword admin --ParentFolderId 'fd-bVaRIG0000' --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the information of members in a folder
description_zh: 调用ListAccountsForParent查询资源夹下的成员列表
kebab_example: aliyun resourcedirectorymaster list-accounts-for-parent --parent-folder-id fd-bVaRIG0000 --query-keyword admin --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --tag Value=tag_value Key=tag_key --include-tags true --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAccountsForParent

parameters.help_en:
The keyword used for the query, such as the display name of a member.

Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh:
查询关键字，例如：成员名称。

支持模糊查询
parameters.name: query_keyword

parameters.help_en:
The number of the page to return.

Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码。

起始值：1。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页时每页显示的数据行数。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The tags. This parameter specifies a filter condition
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return information about tags. Valid values:

false (default value)
true
parameters.help_zh:
是否返回标签信息。取值：

false（默认值）：不返回。
true：返回
parameters.name: include_tags

AccountId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member

AccountName.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account name of the member

DeletionStatus.description_en:
The deletion status of the member. Valid values:

Checking: A deletion check is being performed for the member.
Deleting: The member is being deleted.
CheckFailed: The deletion check for the member fails.
DeleteFailed: The member fails to be deleted.

If deletion is not performed for the member, the value of this parameter is empty
DeletionStatus.description_zh:
成员删除状态。取值：
Checking：检查中。
Deleting：删除中。
CheckFailed：检查失败。
DeleteFailed：删除失败。

当账号未发起删除流程时，该字段为空

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the member

JoinMethod.description_en:
The way in which the member joins the resource directory.

invited: The member is invited to join the resource directory.
created: The member is directly created in the resource directory
JoinMethod.description_zh:
成员加入方式。

invited：邀请。
created：创建

JoinTime.description_en: The time when the member joined the resource directory. The time is displayed in UTC

ModifyTime.description_en: The time when the member was modified. The time is displayed in UTC

ResourceDirectoryId.description_en: The ID of the resource directory

Status.description_en:
The status of the member. Valid values:

CreateSuccess: The member is created.
PromoteVerifying: The upgrade of the member is under confirmation.
PromoteFailed: The upgrade of the member fails.
PromoteExpired: The upgrade of the member expires.
PromoteCancelled: The upgrade of the member is canceled.
PromoteSuccess: The member is upgraded.
InviteSuccess: The member accepts the invitation
Status.description_zh:
成员加入状态。取值：

CreateSuccess：创建成功。
PromoteVerifying：升级确认中。
PromoteFailed：升级失败。
PromoteExpired：升级过期。
PromoteCancelled：升级取消。
PromoteSuccess：升级成功。
InviteSuccess：邀请成功

Tag.description_en: The tags that are added to the member

Type.description_en:
The type of the member. Valid values:

CloudAccount: cloud account
ResourceAccount: resource account
Type.description_zh:
成员类型。取值：

CloudAccount：云账号。
ResourceAccount：资源账号

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页时每页显示的数据行数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
